title: Digital Button
slide_intent: Control corner shape consistently so calls to action feel tangible while remaining visually distinct from fully rounded capsules.
strategic_value: A repeatable radius-to-height relationship can make Burger King digital calls to action recognizable across banner sizes.
demonstration: The left text defines a corner-radius rule beside an isolated red Order Now button and a promotional banner containing a second call to action.
practical_value: Set button corner radius to 25% of its vertical height and avoid capsule shapes; treat the banner as inspiration only.

content_islands.name: Button rule
content_islands.spec: Place the tactile rationale and radius prohibition at left.

content_islands.name: Isolated control
content_islands.spec: Show the red Order Now button above the application example.

content_islands.name: Banner example
content_islands.spec: Place the chicken-nugget promotional banner below and retain its Image for inspiration only qualification near the footer.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text says slightly rounded corners give digital buttons a more tactile appearance.
reference_purposes.Application: An isolated button and promotional banner demonstrate the corner treatment.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The corner radius should always be 25% of button height; fully rounded capsule shapes are prohibited. The banner is marked inspiration only.

ingredient.name: Digital button corners
ingredient.role: Give calls to action a consistent, tactile contour.
ingredient.application: Set corner radius to 25% of the button’s vertical height; do not fully round into a capsule.
ingredient.scope: Historical digital CTA guidance. The promotional banner is an inspirational example, not a complete production specification.
